fun_facts: Jonah Coleman was born in Stockton, California.
Jonah Coleman played his first two college seasons at Arizona and his last two at Washington.
In 2023, Jonah Coleman led Arizona in rushing with 871 yards and earned All-Pac-12 honorable mention.
Jonah Coleman scored five rushing touchdowns in one 2025 game, tying Washington’s modern single-game program record.
Jonah Coleman finished college with 3,054 rushing yards and 34 rushing touchdowns.

basis.reasoning: The career entry lists both Arizona and Washington in order, making Washington the last college Jonah Coleman played for.

excerpts:
Enter [Jonah Coleman](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4702555/jonah-coleman) , the Broncos' fourth-round pick last month. The 22-year-old's ball-carrying chops are well-established, as the 5-foot-8, 220-pounder averaged 5.5 yards per carry in four college seasons (two at Arizona, two at Washington) and scored a combined 25 rushing touchdowns for the Huskies the past two years.

That running prowess drew the Broncos in during predraft evaluations, but they also concluded that Coleman was the most proficient pass protector of this running back class.

excerpts:
# Jonah Coleman sets career high with 5 rushing touchdowns, Washington trounces UC Davis

* * *

By AP

Sep 7, 2025, 03:31 am

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

SEATTLE -- — [Jonah Coleman](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4702555/jonah-coleman) rushed for a career-high five touchdowns as Washington beat UC Davis 70-10 on Saturday night.

Coleman tied the modern program record set by Corey Dillon (1996 vs. UCLA) and Hugh McElhenny (1950 vs. Washington State) on a 5-yard rushing touchdown early in the third quarter. Ervin Daily set the school's all-time mark with seven rushing touchdowns against Whitman in 1919.

## RUNNING BACK

## [Jonah Coleman](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4702555/jonah-coleman) , [Washington Huskies](https://www.espn.com/college-football/team/_/id/264/washington-huskies)

**Key numbers** : 756 rushing yards, 15 rushing TDs, 156 carries, 354 receiving yards, 31 receptions, two receiving TDs in 2025. Coleman, who played his first two college seasons at Arizona and followed coach Jedd Fisch to Washington, eclipsed 750 rushing yards in each of his final three seasons, while showing impressive versatility with 77 receptions. He averaged 5.5 yards per rush during his career and had 3,054 yards with 34 TDs.
